faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our OJS hosting services

items.q: What versions of OJS do you support?
items.a: We support OJS 3.3, 3.4 and 3.5 (LTS since June 2026). We can also help you migrate from earlier versions, including OJS 2.x.

items.q: Can I migrate my existing OJS installation?
items.a: Yes, we offer migration services to help you move your existing OJS installation to our hosting platform.
Yes, all our hosting plans include free SSL certificates to ensure your journal is secure.

items.q: How often do you update OJS?
items.a: We apply security updates as soon as they're available. Major version upgrades are scheduled with your approval.

items.q: Can I use my own domain name?
items.a: Yes, all plans let you use your own domain or subdomain.

items.q: What kind of support do you offer?
items.a: All plans include 24/7 AI assistance via WhatsApp, plus OJS expert support during business hours: email support on Basic, priority email support on Professional, and priority email and phone support on Enterprise.
